sourceTruth.rule: All product outcomes, operations, guards, UI semantics, journeys, scenario steps and media recording requirements come from current source-pinned PDP-0 to PDP-3; this file is a replaceable Build execution projection and editorial overlay, never a normative duplicate.

selectionPolicy.earliestEligible: Select the first **already implemented** customer-valuable PDP-0 terminal outcome with corresponding PDP-1 owner result, PDP-2 approved/implemented channel semantics and PDP-3 real step/channel success evidence. No dependency on unrelated verticals or release. No infrastructure-only or Explorer-mock film.
selectionPolicy.allowedFallback: A different source-defined business journey can become the first film only after its own terminal postcondition and recorder admission pass; record exact changed source refs and owner decision rather than silently relabeling an upload or technical smoke test.
selectionPolicy.noCrossJourneyFinality: J-03 is a reviewable caption version; this profile does not claim reviewer approval (J-21), exported delivery or remote publishing (J-22), or product release.
selectionPolicy.firstChannelCompletionRule: Every normative step and customer terminal result implemented through one declared real channel with applicable failure/UNKNOWN recovery. Other J03 channels and full V03 remain open for independent Build parity.

firstCandidate.title: From authorized audio recording to corrected reviewable captions
firstCandidate.endUserOutcome: A creator/editor can work from a real verified source, receive actual transcription, correct words/timing, register and inspect a reviewable immutable caption version with source/language/timing/provenance/uncertainty.

recorderReuse.adopter: Media-owned source-bound adapter; Gharbatai stories/data/demo drivers do not migrate
recorderReuse.qualification: Pinned private source-composite permitted for local development only after packed/export consumer tests, license/security admission, Playwright/browser isolation and actual product-effect receipt comparison. Not proof of published production dependency.

storyboard.policy: Editorial beats only. Generate actionable commands, selectors and expected finalities from source-authoritative PDP1/PDP2/PDP3 bindings. Never hardcode route, CSS selector, undocumented command or new product semantics in this file.

scenes.narrationIntent: Identify the creator's need to turn permitted audio into reviewable timed captions.
Show the right project and workspace, not an invented login or project.

scenes.purpose: Original audio integrity and source attachment
scenes.narrationIntent: Demonstrate safe, reproducible upload or import and verified original bytes.
Show real work and distinguish acceptance from finished recognition.

scenes.purpose: Review and correct transcript words and caption timing
scenes.narrationIntent: Show the person correcting the words and timing while preserving original provenance.

scenes.purpose: Register and inspect immutable reviewable caption version
scenes.narrationIntent: Show the completed source-defined business outcome, not a queued job.

scenes.purpose: Optional safe failure and recovery evidence
scenes.narrationIntent: Explain a genuine failure boundary without inventing or forcing an unobserved successful effect.

admission.sourceDefinedScopeRule: Product prerequisite package IDs name authoritative component owners; their end-to-end outcome *subtasks* for the chosen actual source-authorized channel, not whole-package multi-channel completion, are the first-film prerequisite. Full package dependencies remain in canonical plan. F-READY and Kernel stage admission still apply.

productPrerequisiteAcceptance.M-BLD-V01: REAL SOURCE-AUTHORIZED CHANNEL PROJECT/IDENTITY RESULT; FULL PACKAGE MAY REMAIN OPEN
productPrerequisiteAcceptance.M-BLD-V02: REAL VERIFIED SOURCE VERSION AND METADATA; OTHER CHANNELS MAY REMAIN OPEN
productPrerequisiteAcceptance.M-BLD-V20: DURABLE SAME-JOB OBSERVATION AND RECONCILIATION ON FILMED CHANNEL
productPrerequisiteAcceptance.M-BLD-V03: REAL QUALIFIED STT, CORRECTED CAPTION VERSION AND PDP3 TERMINAL READBACK ON ONE SOURCE-AUTHORIZED CHANNEL; FULL V03 ALL-CHANNEL PARITY MAY REMAIN OPEN
productPrerequisiteAcceptance.M-BLD-L01: ONLY T01-T04 QUALIFIED FOR FIRST FILM; GENERAL MODALITY/DEVICE/STREAM CAPTURE REMAINS OPEN

dataAndQuality.fixtureProfile: Synthetic, consented, licensed test audio with intelligible phrases and intentional correctable timing/text mistakes; real media bytes processed through a real admitted STT engine, not a prerecorded transcript posed as inference.
dataAndQuality.fixtureProvisioning: Idempotent isolated demo tenant/workspace; deterministic seed identifiers; ownership/lease-scoped cleanup of only generated resources; avoid arbitrary database resets.
dataAndQuality.capture: Native browser/terminal/media capture grounded in actual host/runtime; source clocks and wall/media timelines kept separate; headless is allowed, explorer-only pixels are not.
dataAndQuality.privacy: No passwords/tokens/customer recordings/PII/biometric samples in output frames, logs, narration or bundle; consent and license verified for soundtrack, fonts and source content.
dataAndQuality.quality: Sound, framing, pacing, captions, accessibility, artifacts and visual continuity measured against owner-approved profile; no invented thresholds; crop/annotation or AI polish may not hide denied/UNKNOWN states.
dataAndQuality.narration: Declarative storyboard/captions with human review or qualified TTS; narration must follow observed output and may be manually edited without affecting business-source receipts.
dataAndQuality.automaticReRecording: On source/product UI changes, compare semantic and visual anchors to invalidate only affected scenes while preserving approved manual edits and immutable old film versions.
dataAndQuality.approvalBoundary: Recording may be captured after conditions are met; 'APPROVED_FILM' requires real file inspection and reviewer disposition; no film or external publication is currently approved.

successPolicy: FIRST_FILM_TRIGGER = CURRENT_PDP_SOURCE_AND_REAL_BUSINESS_OUTCOME_AND_CAPTURE_READY; then capture now, verify output, review film. Never gate first film on V24/V29/all verticals/full Studio or Delivery.
